title: Fujifilm X100VI: Why TikTok’s Favourite Camera Sells Out
description: Why the Fujifilm X100VI became TikTok’s favourite camera, why it’s so hard to buy, what reviewers think, and the best alternatives you can actually get.
h1: Fujifilm X100VI: why TikTok’s favourite camera keeps selling out
intro: A premium compact camera became a social media status symbol. Here’s why, and what to buy if you can’t find one.

image.alt: A black and grey compact camera on a wooden table

cardText: Why TikTok’s favourite camera is so hard to buy, and the alternatives.

sections.html: Its predecessor, the X100V, blew up on TikTok thanks to Fujifilm’s “film simulation” colour looks, which make photos feel like film straight out of the camera. The X100VI, launched in 2024, added a 40MP sensor and in-body stabilisation, and demand outstripped supply. TechRadar reported months-long back orders.

DPReview and others praised the image quality, stabilisation and handling. The repeated catches: modest battery life, a fixed 35mm-equivalent lens, and a single UHS-I card slot that’s slow for big RAW files, as Tom’s Guide noted.

Scarcity has pushed second-hand and reseller prices above retail at times. Buy from authorised retailers, join official waiting lists, and be wary of “in stock” listings from unknown sellers on social ads.

• Ricoh GR IIIx / GR III: smaller and pocketable, with a big fan base among street photographers.
  • A used X100V: most of the experience without stabilisation.
  • Canon G7 X Mark III: for vlogging and flash-photo digicam vibes.
